1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP comprises an RFID tag with a unique identifier that is machine-readable only when the test tube is positioned in a specific orientation relative to a reader device.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube and is not accessible from the exterior surface of the test tube.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards, and wherein the MTP is sealed within the test tube material such that it is not exposed to external contamination.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube designed for long-term storage of biological samples at cryogenic temperatures.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer, and wherein the embedding process comprises heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP to create a permanent bond.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

13. (Currently Amended) A system for storing samples comprising: the assembly of claim 1; a rack specifically designed for biorepository test tubes; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes, wherein the system integrates RFID tracking of individual test tubes with automated sample management.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13, wherein the system is adapted for low temperature operation such that the racks and test tubes are handled and stored at -20°C or less, and wherein the reader device maintains the embedded MTP at -20°C or less during reading operations.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: heating the MTP to above the melting point of plastic; and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP to embed the MTP within the plastic material of the test tube.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing a test tube assembly with an embedded MTP; positioning the test tube in a reader device; and reading the MTP using the reader device.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

(Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer, and wherein the embedding process comprises heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP to create a permanent bond.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards, and wherein the MTP is sealed within the test tube material such that it is not exposed to external contamination.
